title: Glessner's 18th Street chimney slimmed to its drawn depth
items: The chimney stack on the Glessner House's 18th Street gable is half a foot shallower, 2.6 ft deep where it was 3.1, as the 1965 survey's east elevation draws it. Seen from Prairie and 18th, it now stands as slim as it does in the 1887 photograph.
